A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same POLYRATING work. Their complete 25-page documents, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original bias estimates, sample-efficiency experiments, and fitted leaderboards in Section 4, plus alternative-rating comparisons and detailed results in Appendices B and E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical analyses and results in Section 4 and Appendices B and E.

M1.justification: The feature-based rating model, MAP objective, Gaussian priors, Newton/L-BFGS optimization, and benchmark win-rate adjustment remain unchanged. Edits around the method equations clarify prose without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use Chatbot Arena, Wildbench, and MixEval-Hard with the same coverage, including English, Chinese, code, hard questions, combined Chinese-code questions, and human versus LLM judging.

E2.justification: The univariate and constant-rating comparisons remain unchanged. Appendix B and Figure 4 retain the same Bradley–Terry, Davidson, Rao–Kupper, and accuracy-based rating comparisons.

E3.justification: Training-size sweeps, held-out evaluation, normalized logistic loss, cross-validation of prior variance, benchmark scaling, and the univariate leaderboard's fixed Mixtral rating remain unchanged. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Appendix B retains the same investigation of whether explicit draw modeling or accuracy-based ratings improve prediction. The other analyses and case studies are also unchanged; no ablation or robustness analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions retain bootstrap uncertainty estimation, main-text 2-sigma intervals, and the appendix's 95% interval reporting. There are no changes to disclosed run counts, seeds, or statistical procedures.

E6.justification: Figures 2–4 and all result tables retain identical values, curves, rankings, and entries, including the complete appendix leaderboards. Section 4's reported sample-efficiency improvements and bias findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, alternative-rating formulas, and Appendix C theorems and proofs are unchanged. Correcting 'convex with and twice differentiable' is grammatical, not a revision to the mathematical claim.

C1.justification: The introduction's contribution bullet qualifies the new-model evaluation-cost reduction from '41%' to 'up to 41%', aligning it with the already-qualified abstract. The remaining contributions and conclusion retain their meaning and scope.

C2.justification: The bias interpretations, explanations of leaderboard differences, and Section 6 limitations concerning relative performance and manual feature selection remain unchanged. The removed Impact Statement largely repeats evaluation and fairness benefits retained elsewhere.

D1.justification: v1's explicit code repository link is replaced by a supplementary-material pointer. A new Reproducibility Statement says the supplement includes code and execution instructions and points to existing Appendix C proofs. This changes documented access information; the supplement's contents cannot be verified from the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: The bibliography and substantive positioning against previous rating systems and LLM evaluation methods are unchanged. Citation-order edits and reference reflow do not add or remove cited works.

P1.justification: v2 lightly rewrites the abstract, corrects grammar and punctuation, and refines method exposition. It replaces the Impact Statement with a Reproducibility Statement while retaining the main section and appendix organization.

P2.justification: The shorter statement on page 10 shifts acknowledgements and references upward and changes subsequent reference page breaks. There is also limited prose reflow; Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–8 retain their displays, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 provides modest grammatical cleanup and a more carefully qualified contribution bullet, while retaining the same scientific argument, experiments, results, and appendix proofs. Its reproducibility statement adds an assurance about supplementary instructions but replaces a concrete repository link with a less specific access pointer. These limited editorial and documentation changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or decline.
